ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Cupid Limited has approved the conversion of up to 3 million warrants in Baazar Style Retail Limited into equity shares, involving a significant cash outlay of approximately ₹73.86 Crores. This strategic investment aims to materially expand Cupid's retail presence and consumer reach by leveraging Baazar Style's growing network of fashion retail stores for distributing Cupid's FMCG product portfolio. The key consideration is the substantial diversification of a condom and IVD manufacturer into a specialty fashion retail business, which presents new operational and market integration risks.
